title: Hospora
description: Connected hospitality platform bringing bookings, online orders, vouchers, purchasing, staff time, analytics, alerts, and email into one system. Helps venues manage day-to-day operations across web and mobile.

title: Jumpy Jar
description: Early childhood education marketplace where creators sell digital learning resources to educators and parents. Helps educators discover resources to support early learning, while giving creators a place to share and sell their work.

title: FearAlert
description: Email alert service that lets subscribers create custom rules based on the Fear & Greed Index and other technical indicators, then receive alerts when their conditions are met. $2/week subscription.
